issue_request: FHIR-33973 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to clarify that SubscriptionTopic.notificationShape.resource is the subscription focus and aligns with SubscriptionTopic.eventTrigger.resource and SubscriptionTopic.canFilterBy.resource when those elements are present.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies commit 0f0727da15874cb2bcec967a805c088f1370cdc1 as the application. That commit updated the SubscriptionTopic StructureDefinition and notes so canFilterBy.resource and notificationShape.resource describe focus/root resources linked to resourceTrigger.resource or eventTrigger.resource.
additional_context: FHIR-46492 later collapsed resourceTrigger and eventTrigger into SubscriptionTopic.trigger, and moved canFilterBy and notificationShape under trigger. FHIR-39029 and FHIR-39030 added additional notificationShape resource-linking clarification, and fhir.ini maps the old element paths to the current trigger paths.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active StructureDefinition and narrative already say trigger.canFilterBy.resource and trigger.notificationShape.resource are focus/root resources and are the same, a generality, or a specificity of SubscriptionTopic.trigger.resource when present.
